build_session_key: build a deterministic session key from a SessionSource for routing and session isolation
get_or_create_session: get an existing session or create a new one with auto-reset policy evaluation from a SessionSource
build_session_context_prompt: build a dynamic system prompt section describing session context with optional PII redaction
load_transcript: load all messages from a session's transcript preferring SQLite or falling back to legacy JSONL
append_to_transcript: append a message to a session's transcript in both SQLite and legacy JSONL storage
